$comment: Genesis paper for the rrxiv protocol. The canonical instance has minted the id_slug rrxiv:2605.00001; if you fork to a different instance, leave id_slug null until that instance mints its own. The versions[] array records the lineage of prior submissions so scripts/submit.sh can auto-resolve --revision-of. v2 was retired in May 2026 (Sprint 8.5: stale CIR cleanup) — the active lineage on the canonical instance is v1 → v3 → v4 → v5 → v6 → v7.
title: rrxiv: An Open Protocol for Research Preprints in the Era of Human-Agent Coproduction

versions.notes: Initial seed submission via scripts/rebuild-seed.sh — pre-canonical id format.
First open-ORCID submission via the dogfood flow; CIR-only (no PDF/source bundle), id_slug typo'd to rrxiv-0001 in the tex.
Adds the testable-invariants section; still CIR-only — Sprint 12 audit found the PDF + tarball never made it to the server.
First submission via the canonical multipart pipeline (scripts/submit.sh + agent identity), but server-side bug meant source.uri/rendered_pdf_uri did not stick — fixed by rrxiv-python#50 + v6 below.

Re-minted under RRP-0029: the machine id is now a server-assigned UUIDv7 (opaque); id_slug rrxiv:2605.00001 is the stable citable identifier and claim ids are slug-based. Current deployed head as of the 2026-05-30 corpus re-mint.
